def clear_and_type(x,y,text):
    click_at_xy(x,y)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', modifiers=2)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
    press_key('Backspace')
    type_text(text)

def set_text(backend_id, text):
    cdp('DOM.focus', backendNodeId=backend_id)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', commands=['selectAll'])
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
    press_key('Backspace')
    type_text(text)
